t1 COMPLETE — Forever HUD cooldown/GCD/secret API contract delivered (read-only lane, no product edits).

Artifacts: bench/forever_hud_api_2026-11-08.md (760 lines, §1–12), desks/forever-hud-api/journal.md, desks/forever-hud-api/.signals/2026-11-09T024130Z.json. Client pinned: origin/forever eac30af59, 1.60.1 (70790). Every client claim cited origin/forever:<path>:<line>; runtime-only facts are UNCONFIRMED with exact /run probes (P1–P11 / U1–U12).

Five things the implementer must act on:

1) THE SWIPE IS ACHIEVABLE UNDER RESTRICTION — prior bench is wrong. C_Spell.GetSpellCooldownDuration (SpellDocumentation.lua:326-343) has NO SecretWhenCooldownsRestricted (GetSpellCooldown :312 does), so its LuaDurationObject is a non-secret handle whose values may be secret (HasSecretValues, LuaDurationObjectAPIDocumentation.lua:350-364). CooldownFrame:SetCooldownFromDurationObject (FrameAPICooldownDocumentation.lua:307-318) is the ONLY cooldown setter without SecretArgumentsAddAspect. SecretArguments=AllowedWhenUntainted refuses secret ARGUMENTS only — Blizzard states it in prose at Blizzard_UnitFrame/Shared/UnitFrameUtil.lua:487. Supersedes bench/secret_api_matrix_2026-11-06.md:156 + bench/secret_hud_fix_2026-11-06.md:17 ("swipe cannot be driven from a restricted read").

2) COUNTDOWN TEXT has a no-Lua path: C_DurationUtil.CreateDurationTextBinding + SetFontString/SetDuration/SetFormatter(C_StringUtil.CreateSecondsFormatter) + SetTextColorCurve(C_CurveUtil.CreateColorCurve, Enum.DurationTextBindingProperty.RemainingDuration) — text AND warn colour rendered natively. Never format a secret (SecondsFormatter:Format is AllowedWhenUntainted) and never read the text back (GetText = SecretReturnsForAspect Text).

3) GCD: detection without numbers via SpellCooldownInfo.isOnGCD / .isActive (both NeverSecret, SpellSharedDocumentation.lua:26,30); swipe from GetSpellCooldownDuration(probe,false) (ignoreGCD defaults false). Root cause of today's dark GCD: LibGlobalCooldown.poll_gcd:152-171 reads api.GetSpellCooldown, which compat answers 0,0,0,0,true under restriction (compat.lua:471-473) → the ==0 early-out means gcd_duration never arms.

4) TRINKET CONTRACT BUG (independent of the cooldown work, live today): the 4th return of GetInventoryItemCooldown is isOnGCD (Blizzard's own Forever code, Blizzard_CooldownViewer/CooldownViewer.lua:1017,1021), but compat.lua:1565-1584 + hud.lua:341-350,418-431 read it as `restricted` → an on-use trinket paints the grey unknown face and drops its swipe for the whole GCD window. No duration-object API for item cooldowns exists anywhere in the branch (enumerated all LuaDurationObject returners) and no item secrecy predicate exists.

5) CACHES: a secret table key poisons every access and hard-errors (Blizzard_AuraContainerGroups.lua:12-25); the secure secretunwrap+settablesecurity pattern is unavailable to addons (secretunwrap = nil, Blizzard_EnvironmentCleanup/Mainline/EnvironmentCleanup.lua:280) while scrubsecretvalues/issecretvalue survive. All six addon cache groups mapped with minimal fixes, incl. replacing icons[i].cd_start/cd_duration with the object handle + a plain token, and keeping the compat nil-on-secret contracts.

Recommendation: run P1–P11 in one Forever session first (they decide the visible face, not the design), then implement the object channel of §6.4 behind Forever + GetSpellCooldownDuration probes so every other client stays byte-identical. No blockers; idle and available for follow-ups.

T2 DONE (attempt 1). source_task_id=t2 source_attempt_id=5243edcf-2352-4bb5-8e8e-b64c13f589aa

Deliverables (read-only lane, no product edits):
- bench/aura_row_reference_2026-11-08.md (869 lines)
- desks/aura-row-reference/journal.md + .signals/20261109T025200Z.json (done)

The impl lane (T3) can build aura_icons.lua from §6 without opening the reference addon. What it needs that is not obvious:

1) SECRET GEOMETRY (biggest port hazard, changes the design): the client sizes aura containers via secretwrap (origin/forever Blizzard_CustomAuraContainer.lua:796-801), so container GetHeight/GetTop can be secret — the reference already refuses to measure its debuff row (SuperSwingTimer_Forever.lua:1380-1398). Port must NOT anchor the buff row to the measured debuff row. §6.5 reserves a fixed band from configured icon size + bar top only. Test case 12 asserts zero container-geometry reads.
2) Own-caster debuffs: no CLEU needed. "HARMFUL|PLAYER" is the client filter (AuraUtil.lua:274). Also includeSpellIDs identity matching is privilege-gated (Blizzard_AuraContainerUtil.lua:52-107): the debuff row is empty on friendly targets by design — tell the operator.
3) No classic fallback needed: UnitAura does not exist on Forever (classic-only deprecated shims behind a CVar + AllowLoadGameType classic).
4) Ids: post-merge buffs 26/17/9/12/22/11 = 97; debuffs 29/19/19/30/19/44 = 160 after excluding 27019 (reference-marked TBC-only); shared 5; racial 10 keys. Stance ids (Aspects/Seals/Stances/Shields/Forms/Stealth) are a separate left-slot feature — not ported, must not leak into the buff row. 18 ids (every FOREVER_NEW_ABILITY_CANDIDATES entry) sit in BOTH rows by the reference's double merge; recommended to keep and pin by test (one-line change if you prefer buff-only).
5) Gate: st.family == "FOREVER" + C_AuraContainerUtil + both sort enums + the CreateFrame template probe (pcall; retry, never latch). Init seam: main.lua post_init through the ST:init_weave_range pattern (no class-file edits needed). Options: aura_icons_enabled/size/spacing/grow/show_debuffs in ST.class_defaults, controls at order ~2.9, hidden when st.family ~= "FOREVER".
6) Reference docs are stale in 4 places (WIRING.md 0.25 s vs the 0.15 s constant; ns.foreverAuraPending does not exist; "classic updaters are NOT wrapped" while WrapLegacyIconUpdaters runs at init+per tick; "native row shown only while IsAuraDataSecret" which the code never checks). Do not inherit them.

UNCONFIRMED (runtime only, no Forever client run by this lane): tainted creation of CustomAuraContainerTemplate, secret-safe behaviour in combat/instances, container geometry secrecy, group own-caster filtering, per-class topmost-bar placement — U1-U13 with exact /run probes in §8.

t4 (Forever-only aura icon row) COMPLETED. source_task_id=t4 source_attempt_id=cf530ca1-eaee-4b13-857d-c4a3edeee8aa.

SHIPPED
- NEW aura_icons.lua (1279 lines): gate = st.family=="FOREVER" + C_AuraContainerUtil + both sort enums + CreateFrame("AuraContainer", template) probe. Two native rows: HELP FUL/player buffs (maxDuration 180, hides permanent/passive ids) and HARMFUL|PLAYER/target own-caster debuffs (no CLEU; empty on friendly targets by the client's identity-filter rule). Per-class post-merge Forever lists: buffs 26/17/9/12/22/11=97, debuffs 29/19/19/30/19/44=160, shared 5 buff-only, racial 10 keys (file token then localized); 27019 + removed druid ids excluded; stance tier never merged; shared/racial merged into a copy at container creation only. Never measures an aura container (client writes geometry through secretwrap) — fixed reserved band above the topmost VISIBLE swing bar from the addon's own bar geometry (iter_hands/get_bar_frame, highest plain GetTop wins, secret/unreadable skipped). 0.15 s maintenance, 0.5 s no-latch creation retry, forced PLAYER_ENTERING_WORLD pass. Native containers never created in combat lockdown; a plain retry driver is the only frame that may exist then.
- Wiring: SwedgeTimer.toc (line 67, after hud.lua), main.lua guarded ST:init_aura_icons() seam (1054-1074) + one post_init call (1138), config_presets.lua 5 nil-safe defaults (133-145), option_tables.lua ST:aura_icon_options_args() (212-476) merged into the Behaviour page (673-679) and hidden on every non-Forever family, tests/run.sh (line 77), tests/toc_check.lua REQUIRED_MODULES (line 402). option_table_presets.lua untouched; version unchanged (2.1.8); no git; hud/compat/LibGlobalCooldown/classes/bars untouched by this lane.

EVIDENCE
- NEW tests/aura_icons_state.lua (1582 lines, 853 checks, red-first: exit 1 before the module existed). Covers non-Forever inertness (0 frames/events/aura reads), exact id sets all 6 classes + no leak + exclusions, secrecy (identical calls secret/readable, 0 aura reads, C_Secrets only in diagnostics), placement/hide-fallback/re-anchor/throttle/secret geometry, combat deferral + no-latch retry, style callback, options/defaults/TOC/main-seam pins.
- bash tests/run.sh: 59 steps, 0 failed; luacheck 8 warnings/0 errors in 105 files (new files 0/0); luac5.1 -p clean.
- 12 mutation proofs on isolated /tmp copies, all exit 1: gate family 55 fails, own-caster filter 2, top comparator 15, container measure 9, shared merge 11, creation latch 4, 27019 4, throttle 2, secret-geometry guard 3, option family 5, main seam 2, TOC line 3. M9 first passed and exposed a fixture weakness (table-shaped fake secret) — replaced with a numeric secret sentinel and re-proven.

ARTIFACTS: bench/aura_row_2026-11-08.md (393 lines: file:line map, gate/lifecycle diagram, shipped id tables with provenance, evidence, mutation table, 15-row in-client UNCONFIRMED checklist with exact /run probes), desks/aura-row/journal.md + .signals/2026-11-09T031013Z.json.

IN-CLIENT STILL OPEN: U1 tainted template creation, U7 secret-safe combat updates, U8 container SetPoint/Show in combat, U9 container-geometry secrecy, U10 topmost-bar visual stack per class (full list + probes in the report §6). No blocker for review; workspace is shared with other lanes (their in-flight edits explain luacheck 8 vs 9 between runs).

t3 COMPLETE (attempt 1, 979874ee-8826-4232-b937-1fd8ec9b7cb4). Forever secret-safe HUD cooldown/GCD implemented + cache hardened; full green tree.

Files: hud.lua, compat.lua (additive helpers only), LibGlobalCooldown.lua, tests/hud_state.lua, tests/forever_secret_compat_state.lua, bench/hud_forever_cooldown_2026-11-08.md, desks/hud-cooldown-fix/ (journal + done signal 2026-11-09T032034Z). No git/version/TOC/config/options/main/bars/classes/docs edits; tests/secret_guard_state.lua untouched.

Path: on Forever while the provider flags `restricted`, paint acquires C_Spell.GetSpellCooldownDuration(slot spell, ignoreGCD=false) and passes the opaque handle to CooldownFrame:SetCooldownFromDurationObject(obj,true); countdown via C_DurationUtil binding + seconds formatter + warn colour curve (client formats/colours; never read back); 2 s GCD text rule from the plain NeverSecret isOnGCD field; GCD rides the same object and LibGlobalCooldown gains the additive object channel. Readable states keep the exact old numeric face on every client. SEC-13: state scrub at provider→paint, boolean-field secrets land on the unknown/no-cue face, known_names/known_cache/HUD.trinkets proven plain before use (poisoned entries dropped).

Evidence: bash tests/run.sh 59 steps / 0 failed; hud_state 1024/1024 (+131); forever_secret_compat 250/250 (+73); secret_guard 524/524; luacheck 2 warnings / 0 errors in 105 files (pre-existing tree floor); luac clean. Mutation proofs: 8 single-site mutants on isolated copies, 7 kill exit 1 (34/41/1/3/11/6/2 of 1024; M8 4/250), M5 (scrub removal) survives offline and is documented honestly (Lua 5.1 can't emulate raise-on-comparison; paint-boundary twins bite).

Deviations flagged in report §6: T1 §7's trinket fourth-return defect is not in this tree (compat reads 3 values; 4th is compat's SEC-10 flag; contract change forbidden) — flagged for a future contract revision; UNIT_SPELLCAST_INTERRUPTED keeps the cross-lane-pinned release shape (object channel is the real release path); GCD wiring split HUD-paint vs LGC-state because main.lua is out of scope.

Only remaining unknowns are client-only: probes P4/P5 (does the engine accept a secret-valued object from tainted code and render the binding) — pcall fallback is the grey unknown face. No blockers; ready for t5 verification.

t5 COMPLETE — verdict: both lanes PASS, no blocker, no secret/taint defect, no non-Forever behaviour change. Deliverables: bench/hud_forever_verification_2026-11-08.md (585 lines), desks/aura-hud-verify/journal.md, desks/aura-hud-verify/.signals/2026-11-09T034100Z.json. Read-only lane: no product/test/TOC/config/docs file written, no git in the repo.

Independent evidence (current tree, not copied from the reports):
- bash tests/run.sh 59 steps / 0 failed; luacheck 2 warnings / 0 errors / 105 files (both pre-existing hunter_ui.lua:135-136, untouched); luac5.1 -p clean; LF only; no lint silencing.
- Counts: hud_state 1024, forever_secret_compat_state 250, aura_icons_state 853, secret_guard_state 524 (unmodified), toc_check 360.
- Pre-existing checks intact: truncating the new sections out of copies gives exactly 893 and 177 checks / 0 failures (the stated baselines).
- Mutations: all 20 implementer mutants reproduce their exact failing counts; t3's declared M5 scrub survivor reproduces; spot-checked failures name the intended mechanism; my extra mutant bypassing compat.lua:398's HasSecretValues()~=false refusal DOES fail (4 checks) → the pre-existing object reader is pinned.
- Getter discipline proven directly: HasSecretValues()==true + every getter raising → GetSpellCooldown degrades to 0,0,0,0,true and the new helper returns the handle without calling any getter (259 checks / 0 failed). No product code calls any duration-object value getter.
- 19-path gate audit: every Forever path is st.family=="FOREVER" + exact probe; st.is_mainline alone gates nothing new; aura_icons.lua is inert (0 frames/0 events/0 aura reads) on all six non-Forever families; single TOC (line 67 after hud.lua); aura module's only ST surface is 5 read-only getters, so no existing visual can move.
- Full cache table audited (known_names, known_cache, layout_cache, HUD.icons, HUD.trinkets, TRINKET_STATE, PREVIEW_STATE, SAFE_STATE, LibGlobalCooldown numeric+object state, aura_icons state, compat tables) — plain-by-construction or re-proved before use; no secret can become a key.

Findings for you to rule on (all low, none blocking; I did not fix them): F1 aura_icons.lua:4/:11 two comment typos ("WO W", "HELP FUL"); F2 stray luac.out (compiled LibGlobalCooldown) in the repo root — not TOC-listed so unloadable, delete before release; F3 aura_icons.lua:944-953 a post-CreateFrame setup failure leaves the named container so later CreateFrame retries error on the real client (trigger: invalid db.frame_strata; no test injector) — fix by clearing/reusing the global name; F4 resize_group_frames (aura_icons.lua:810-829) can be denied under aura secrecy while sync_layout still records the new size (cosmetic mixed sizes until the next size change); F5 t4 report says "6 hidden widgets" where the builder contributes 7 args entries. F6 info: one extra pcall + family compare per painted icon per tick on classic (hud.lua:1547) — no behaviour change. F7/F8 UNCONFIRMED runtime: engine acceptance/rendering of a secret-valued LuaDurationObject (U3/U5) and the additive LibGlobalCooldown probe spell 61304 (zero consumers; HUD GCD does not depend on it). F9: the disclosed M5 survivor (keep the scrub).

Operator action: run report §10 probes 4/5 (plus 2-3 for the additive channel) in one restricted Forever moment — the only remaining closers. Nothing needs a code change.
